feature_order._note: Verified against the training source (export_posture_v1.py extract_rep_features_87d): np.mean(coords, axis=0) is [33,3] and .flatten()[:33] takes joints 0..10 x (x,y,z) in row-major order -- NOT 33 joints' x-values. The previous strings copied a mistaken inline comment. Serving (app/ml/posture_v1/features_151d.py) already matched the training behaviour, so this was a documentation defect, not a train/serve skew. MediaPipe body landmarks start at index 11, so features 0-86 contain zero body joints. See AUDIT.md G-24.

_contamination_note: G-44: the training_metrics below were measured on an evaluation set that was partly in training. 18 of the 173 reconstructed binary-task test videos (10.4%) have a byte-identical twin in the TRAIN split -- the corpus contains 105 byte-identical duplicate videos under different names, 45 spanning splits, and the split was partitioned by user id. These figures are UPPER BOUNDS, not estimates, and are deliberately NOT re-measured. See bench/results/2026-09-23-corpus-duplicates.md and bench/contamination_scope.py.
